name: essencial-saude-site
description: Site institucional + CMS proprio da Essencial Saude Auditoria (Etapa 1 - frontend/visual)

scripts.qa: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute essencial-saude-db --local --file=migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute essencial-saude-db --local --file=migrations/0002_posts_cover_url.sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute essencial-saude-db --remote --file=migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute essencial-saude-db --remote --file=migrations/0002_posts_cover_url.sql
scripts.db:studio:local: wrangler d1 execute essencial-saude-db --local --command="SELECT id,name,email,role,status FROM users"
